what: The screen is split into a big cell grid (4 columns × 22.125rem, phone 2 columns × half screen), and each cell blinks black as it transitions — the start time of a cell is .55 for distance from the pressed spot + .45 random, spread over 1.7s. Each cell does black·clear five times over 0 to .3e (e = .8~1.3 random) flickers and at .75 switches to the new page, then goes black twice more at .82 and .97, and ends at 1.05. Only one random cell is the accent color for the first .3. The cells of the new page open with a View Transition between documents (2.95s, phone ×.6), and on first open the cells covering the whole screen lift at the same pace (loader about 2s)

options.row: Cell height (rem), default 22.125 — on phone, half the screen height
options.spread: Length over which cell starts spread out (s), default 1.7
options.dur: Transition length (s), default 2.95 — shorten it for app-like frequent switching (the cell steps stay the same, only the time axis is stretched or shrunk)
options.phone: Swipe duration multiplier on phone, default .6
options.cover · reveal: Cover and uncover durations (seconds) in browsers without View Transition and on file://, default 2.45 · 2.2
options.intro: If 0, turns the loader off on first open (default on)
options.wait: Max time (seconds) the loader waits for images and fonts, default 1.2 — then it rests .15s and lifts
options.look: ink: Use the text color (--kf-ink) for the cell instead of the background color (--kf-bg) — when you want dark cells on a light skin
options.html.fx-tfn-intro · html.fx-tfn-reveal: Mark attached during the loader and for 2 seconds after it lifts — the css using it sets things that float up after the loader, like the bottom menu
options.[data-fx-part=plain]: This link (or links inside it) passes straight through without a slide change

note: Only pages from the same origin transition. Put an empty element at the very end of the page (after the script) so the cells are covered before the first paint, <head> At <link rel="expect" href="#That element" blocking="render"> …is worth attaching. The original also played a short square-wave sound (WebAudio) per cell, but when the document changes the sound permission is cut, so the part makes no sound. The original is a single-page app so every transition runs in the same document, while the part draws the same mask on the new-document side of a cross-document View Transition

from.where: Body on every page — original pixel-transition canvas (4 columns · 22.125rem · 1.7s · steps .07/.15/.22/.3e · .75/.82/.9/.97/1.05 · red cell rgb(235,54,33) · ::view-transition 3.2s pixel-hold · PC mask 1/8 canvas · phone clip-path path · phone length ×.6)
